newFinding.title: Transportation Special Purpose Local Option Sales and Use Tax (TSPLOST)
newFinding.electorate: Part of Fulton County outside City of Atlanta; never county-wide fallback

provenance.sourceOrg: Fulton County Department of Registration and Elections
provenance.quote:
Transportation Special Purpose Local Option Sales and Use Tax (TSPLOST) 
  Yes  or  No
Shall an additional 0.75 percent sales and use tax be imposed in that part of Fulton 
County, Georgia, outside of the City of Atlanta, for a period not to exceed five years 
for the purpose of transportation improvements and congestion reduction.
